sequence_description: I1 proof-integrity check in brokered OIDC SSO: attempt login via the preconfigured OIDC SSO connector where the mock IdP omits nonce in id_token; Logto must reject because the verified proof must match the requested proof constraints.
description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

description:
Assertion FAILED: user_oidc_sso_nonce_bypass_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_oidc_sso_nonce_bypass_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
